description: Reusable authored-pose direction for alchemist player identities. Registry metadata and the staged portrait control identity; this profile supplies master-potion and transmutation choreography.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. The style image must never override the selected identity portrait or player metadata.

identity.motionStyle: expert, inventive, quick, and controlled, with exact vial handling, guarded supplies, decisive throws, and readable reaction follow-through
identity.equipmentRule: Preserve the portrait's goggles, leather apron, elaborate vials, potions, tools, pouches, transmutation markings, and exact item count. Move exactly one established vial at a time; never duplicate it between hand and holder, invent a weapon, or transform permanent gear.
identity.magicRule: All effects are physical alchemy in the portrait's established chemical palette. Reactions originate from the one handled vial or established transmutation tool and remain compact; do not add arcane casting, runes unrelated to depicted equipment, or unexplained aura.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body game character reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is the authoritative {{displayName}} identity portrait; Image 2 is style and proportion reference only. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Create one complete head-to-toe {{displayName}} preserving Image 1's face, ancestry traits, gender presentation, hair, goggles, apron, vials, pouches, tools, markings, palette, and proportions. Do not import identity details from Image 2. {{equipmentRule}} Translate the portrait into a compact expert-inventor silhouette. Use a {{background}} background with no floor or scenery and a square 1:1 canvas with generous padding. Polished hand-authored 16-bit pixel art with crisp pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm top-left highlights, and muted watercolor-and-parchment ramps. One centered alchemist in an alert formula-testing stance facing {{baseFacing}}. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn full-body {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{displayName}} in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. Motion direction: {{motionDirection}}. Overall alchemist motion is {{motionStyle}}. {{poseRequirement}} Preserve exact identity, goggles, apron, palette, proportions, vials, pouches, markings, and tools. {{equipmentRule}} {{magicRule}} Action-specific effects: {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: An analytical breathing loop alternates supply checks, goggle adjustment, and a careful glance at one secured vial before returning it untouched.
idle.effectRule: No active reaction; a tiny liquid glint may remain inside one closed secured vial.

walk.motionDirection: A brisk alternating walk uses real leg compression, one hand stabilizing fragile supplies, free-arm counter-motion, and controlled apron follow-through.
walk.effectRule: No loose flask or reaction; all vials remain closed and secured.

attack.motionDirection: The alchemist identifies a formula, draws exactly one vial, primes it with an established tool or marking, makes a planted throw, observes compact impact, and secures remaining supplies.
attack.effectRule: Show exactly one thrown vial and one compact physical chemical reaction at impact; never show the vial held and airborne simultaneously or add spell-casting.

hurt.motionDirection: A sudden hit triggers an articulated flinch, backward stagger, protective clutch over fragile supplies, low balance catch, inventory check, and alert recovery.
hurt.effectRule: One compact physical impact accent only; no gore, blood, broken bottle, duplicated vial, magic, or uncontrolled cloud.

death.motionDirection: A final impact overwhelms the alchemist, supplies draw close, knees buckle, the body lowers through a sideward collapse, and settles fully fallen.
death.effectRule: No gore, blood, explosion, broken or duplicated vial, magic, or rigid rotation; keep permanent equipment attached and recognizable.

victory.motionDirection: The alchemist confirms success, selects exactly one vial, inspects it, raises it with inspiration, produces a tiny controlled reaction, secures it, and holds a brilliant finish.
victory.effectRule: One handheld vial may produce a tiny contained fizz, puff, or sparkle; never duplicate it or create a spell.
